description_en: You can invoke GetMultiChannelRecording to obtain the multi-track recording of a specified call under a specified instance. In the multi-track recording, the agent's and customer's audio are distributed across different sound channels. During each playback, only one sound channel can be played, meaning you can hear only one party's voice. The format is MKV
description_zh: 调用GetMultiChannelRecording获取指定实例下指定通话的多轨录音，多轨录音中坐席和客户的录音分布在不同的声道上，每次播放时只能单个声道播放，也就是只能听到其中一方的声音，格式为MKV
kebab_example: aliyun ccc get-multi-channel-recording --instance-id ccc-test --contact-id job-65382141036890000 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMultiChannelRecording
